other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.map_tree: primrec map_tree :: "('a⇒'b) ⇒ 'a tree ⇒ 'b tree" where "map_tree f Leaf = Leaf" | "map_tree f (Node l x r) = (Node (map_tree f l) (f x) (map_tree f r))"
formal function definitions.preorder: fun preorder :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a list" where "preorder Leaf = []" | "preorder (Node (l) (x) (r)) = x # preorder l @ preorder r"

formal theorem statement: theorem preorder_map: "preorder (map_tree f t) = map f (preorder t)"
